notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.
